description: We are a team 2-strong and passionate about data analysis, AI, and NCT.
summary: Flashpoint is an AI-powered website that helps people find NASA combustion experiments that matter for fire safety in space. User can pick tags like prevention, detection, suppression, or a place like a lunar base or rover, and the best matches appear first. Each experiment has a short explanation and an “Ask AI” button for questions.
details: Flashpoint lets users filter NASA combustion experiments with simple tags, and the best matches show first in color instead of scores. Clicking an experiment shows why it matters and how it helps on Earth, plus an “Ask AI” chat that already knows which experiment is open. It helps designers, engineers and researchers find the right research fast, with the goal of making space habitats safer and bringing benefits like better smoke detection back to Earth. We built it with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, a small Node.js function on Vercel, and the Groq AI API, with AI help writing the code. It is creative because you can click a topic and ask AI about it directly, with no confusing numbers. We focused on ease of use, accurate answers, keeping our API key private, and letting anyone open the site with a link.
